title: 3D CNN ensemble from planning CT predicts loco-regional control in head and neck cancer
summary: Deep-learning strategies on treatment-planning CT were compared for predicting loco-regional tumour control after radiochemotherapy, using multicentre exploration (206 patients) and independent validation (85 patients) cohorts. An ensemble of 3D CNNs gave the best result (C-index 0.31) and outperformed a clinical model with tumour volume (0.39), significantly stratifying patients by predicted risk.
ai_technology: Ensemble of 3D convolutional neural networks on treatment-planning CT
organization: Helmholtz-Zentrum Dresden-Rossendorf; OncoRay; German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ)

evidence.unknown: Retrospective, modest cohorts; the authors note a prospective validation study is ongoing; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
